title: Fix the rubric first
statement: Fix the scoring rule and the expected answers before measuring, apply them the same way to every option, and leave arguable cases out.
detail:
The three-film comparison's rubric was fixed before looking at the other two films' results, and every row was checked
the same way on each (`g9/review/three-film-comparison/RUBRIC.md`); the kit's template allows a change afterwards only
as a dated correction with its reason (`othello-unit-video/kit/templates/review/rubric.example.md`). In the marking test,
arguable criteria were listed as ambiguous and left out of the score
(`g9/review/2026-10-07-archivist-marking-test/README.md`).
